title: Scalar extension and finite evaluation of an arbitrary integral arrow
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be finite, and let $T$ be a scheme. Fix Chern data $c$ [def-sp-tower-class-chern], assuming only its scalar-unit normalization [def-sp-tower-class-reduction]. For any integral coefficient-linear arrow $f:R_T[0]\to c.rootModule[2]$ and level $n\geq0$, scalar-extend $f$ using $c.scalarUnit^{-1}$, the canonical scalar shift comparison, and the universal lineComparison. Evaluate, identify the target by the pure-tensor lineEvaluation [def-sp-tower-class-diagonal], and forget finite scalars. After precomposition with finiteQuotient, this equals finite evaluation of the underlying integral arrow, precomposed with integerGenerator and postcomposed with rootForget, followed by finiteRootMap [def-sp-tower-class-finite]. The equation is finiteBoundaryEquality with its two canonical endpoint transports. No integral source normalization, Kummer target normalization, or line-bundle construction of $f$ is assumed. The underlying integral arrow is the generic endpoint-transport composite [def-sfb-tower-underlying-arrow]. The scalar-extended arrow is the constructed scalarChernArrow [def-sfb-scalar-chern-arrow]. The displayed equality is the constructed proposition ScalarFiniteBoundary [def-sfb-scalar-finite-boundary].

theorem scalarFiniteBoundary (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    {T : Scheme.{u}} (c : Chern l E T)
    (hc : unitNormalization c.scalar.T
      (SemilinearSections.res.{u + 1, u, u + 1} (coefficientSystemMap l E T))
      c.scalar.adjunction c.scalarUnit (scalarGenerator l E T))
    (f : unit T (Rrings l T) ⟶
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Systems T (Rrings l T)) 0).obj
        c.rootModule)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧) (n : ℕ) :
    ScalarFiniteBoundary l E c f n
